faqs.faqQuestion: How do you select your competition winners?
faqs.faqAnswer: We use an automated computer system driven by an algorithm that selects winners from all the entries received at random whether they’re received by SMS, online, post, phone call or a mixture of methods. Entrants are randomly selected irrespective of any other factors such as whether they’ve entered before or for the first time, the method they used to enter, geographic location, gender or any other information beyond the mobile numbers from which the entries are sent.

faqs.faqQuestion: How will you contact me if I’m the winner?
faqs.faqAnswer:
If you’ve won a prize with us, we will almost always talk to you by phone first – and will advise you of the process to redeem your prize. 
For some of our competitions you may need to be available to answer the phone at specific times, so make sure to refer to the relevant competition’s Terms & Conditions.

faqs.faqQuestion: Can I enter this competition again?
faqs.faqAnswer: Each competition has its own entry limit, so you will need to refer to the relevant competition’s Terms & Conditions. Entry packages available will be made clear on the competition page.

faqs.faqQuestion: Can I buy an entry bundle and use the entries in different competitions?
faqs.faqAnswer: No. Each bundle of entries purchased goes into the draw of the specific competition you bought the entries for. In the case of competitions that are played on the radio, if you want to enter more than one round, you will have to purchase entries for each separate round when each round is open.

faqs.faqQuestion: Can I enter for free?
faqs.faqAnswer: Some of our competitions will have a free route of entry, but not all. Entry options available will be made clear on each competition page.

faqs.faqQuestion: How do I pay for my entries?
faqs.faqAnswer: You can pay for your entries by debit card, via Paypal, Apple Pay, Google Pay or pay via your mobile phone bill.

faqs.faqQuestion: Where can I find recent winners?
faqs.faqAnswer: You can see some of our recent winners here.

faqs.faqQuestion: Who do I contact if I have a question about my entry?
faqs.faqAnswer: If you have questions about your entries, you can contact our Customer Support team here.

faqs.faqQuestion: Can I enter from anywhere in the UK?
faqs.faqAnswer:
For most of our competitions, you are eligible to enter and win if you’re a resident of the United Kingdom and are located in the UK at the time of your entry. 

However you should always check the specific competition rules.

faqs.faqQuestion: Who do I contact if I have a question about my entry?
faqs.faqAnswer: If you have questions about your entries, you can contact our Customer Support team here.

faqs.faqQuestion: Why did my entry/ies fail?
faqs.faqAnswer:
If you selected ‘pay by mobile’ but your entry failed, there are many different reasons for why this could be. Not all mobile networks support this kind of transaction – it’s only available on O2, Vodafone, EE and Three. Otherwise, it could be due to insufficient funds, a block, a monthly cap that’s been exceeded, or another problem with your mobile phone network. You’ll need to contact your network about this. 
If you entered via PayPal and your entry failed, you may have insufficient funds in your account. Please contact PayPal if in doubt. 
If you chose to pay via Debit Card and your entry failed, you may have insufficient funds in your account, or you may have entered the billing details incorrectly, ie. billing address, CVV. Please contact your bank if in doubt. 
If payment via Apple Pay/Google Pay failed, you’ll need to contact your bank about this.

faqs.faqQuestion: I was a winner on another Global Network competition recently. Can I enter?
faqs.faqAnswer: If you’ve won a prize valued at £1,000 or more or you’ve won more than one prize of any value on any of Global’s platforms within the last six months you won’t be eligible to win again until any exclusion period has ended. This exclusion period is detailed in the General Prize Promotions Terms and Conditions and would have been communicated to you when you redeemed your prize.
